newsitem.title: UK: UK MPs to hold two-day debate ahead of EU summit.
newsitem.headline: UK MPs to hold two-day debate ahead of EU summit.

text.p: Britain's parliament will hold a two-day debate on the European Union ahead of the EU summit on December 13-14, leader of the House of Commons Tony Newton said in his statement on future business on Thursday.

He said both Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind and Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke were expected to take part in the debate. Newton did not give the exact timing for the debate, which will be on a motion for the adjournment.

The government announced on Monday it would hold an "extended" debate on the EU following criticism from MPs about the lack of parliamentary debate on documents relating to plans for the introduction of the single European currency.
